resourceProfile.assessment: The complete English and Nynorsk source scope, review metadata, glossary, and project concept references were available locally.

automatedQuality.summary: Translation review checks, typecheck, complete build, route and generated-link checks, and the full test suite passed after the cycle was finalized.

linguisticCritique.summary: A bounded Nynorsk pass identified six trigonometry formulas with an untranslated or inconsistent hypotenuse term; all six were corrected.

competentHumanReview.summary: No competent Nynorsk human review was performed in this cycle; changed IDs remain machine-drafted.

publicationAuthorization.summary: No merge, publication, deployment, or residual-risk authorization was requested or granted for this cycle.

findings.summary: The sine formula retained the English hypotenuse label in the Nynorsk formula.
evidence: The previous expression was sin(θ) = motståande / hypotenuse.

findings.summary: The cosine formula retained the English hypotenuse label in the Nynorsk formula.
evidence: The previous expression was cos(θ) = hosliggjande / hypotenuse.

findings.summary: The tangent formula set did not use the inflected Nynorsk hypotenuse term consistently with the surrounding explanation.
evidence: The formula set used the bare English label hypotenuse elsewhere in the same section.
findings.resolution: Normalized the formula set to Nynorsk side terminology.

findings.summary: The inverse-sine formula retained the English hypotenuse label.
evidence: The previous expression was θ = sin^-1(motståande / hypotenuse).

findings.summary: The inverse-cosine formula retained the English hypotenuse label.
evidence: The previous expression was θ = cos^-1(hosliggjande / hypotenuse).

findings.summary: The inverse-tangent formula retained the English hypotenuse label in the formula set context.
evidence: The inverse formula family used the English hypotenuse label instead of the Nynorsk inflected term.
findings.resolution: Normalized the inverse formula family to Nynorsk side terminology.
